title: NK News — 'Why military strikes on North Korea's nuke program would have made things worse'
snippet: The US war with Iran has raised questions about whether America's bombing campaign can truly eliminate nuclear facilities, reawakening a debate about whether military strikes could have stopped North Korea from going nuclear decades ago. Analysis argues strikes would have accelerated NK's program and triggered regional crisis.
